method.rule: No inference is presented as the Rebbe's words. Corpus-level metadata verification does not imply item-level verification.

corpora.title: אגרות קודש
corpora.verified_metadata: Public Chabad.org series page describes Igrot Kodesh as a chronologically arranged collection of the Rebbe's letters and gives series-level scope information.
corpora.notes: Item-level verification requires exact letter pages or authoritative textual witnesses; preserve edition apparatus and witness status.

corpora.title: תורת מנחם – התוועדויות
corpora.verified_metadata: Chabad.org identifies the series as including maamarim, public talks and public letters; publisher identified as Vaad Hanachos B'Lahak.

corpora.title: לקוטי שיחות
corpora.verified_metadata: Public Chabad.org series page describes Likkutei Sichos as edited talks reviewed by the Rebbe and published over the years.
corpora.notes: Publisher/editorial indexes must remain distinct from research taxonomy.

corpora.title: רשימות
corpora.verified_metadata: Chabad.org exposes a dedicated Reshimos series page with booklet-level navigation and publisher metadata.
corpora.notes: Item-level entries should retain booklet identity and edition/witness distinctions.

corpora.title: ספר המאמרים מלוקט
corpora.verified_metadata: Chabad.org describes the series as maamarim edited/reviewed by the Rebbe and published in individual booklets; publisher identified as Vaad Hanachos B'Lahak.
corpora.notes: Textual status such as מוגה/הנחה/בלתי מוגה must be retained at item level where stated.

corpora.title: JEM / The Living Archive
corpora.verified_metadata: JEM describes The Living Archive as an effort to restore, preserve and provide access to video, audio and photo archives of the Rebbe. JEM's research request page separately identifies video, photo, audio and written-interview access points.
corpora.notes: Recording Witness must be modeled separately for each recording; access and reuse rights must be checked per item.

corpora.title: ספריית אגודת חסידי חב״ד
corpora.notes: Archive holdings are not treated as item-level indexed without direct item access. A public PDF/books area exists, but archive-level and item-level scope still require further mapping.

corpora.title: Igros Kodesh — The English Letters
corpora.verified_metadata: On 17 June 2026 Chabad.org reported Kehot's announcement of a new series prepared by Sichos in English to publish the Rebbe's English-language correspondence. The report states an anticipated corpus of more than 10,000 letters across about 50 volumes, with editorial background and, when possible, recipients' replies and related documents.
corpora.notes: This is a major future response-case corpus because it may preserve initiating correspondence and related documents. The first volume was reported as forthcoming after Tishrei 2026; no assumption is made here that the full archive is publicly accessible.
